prompt: A watercolor illustration depicts a bustling construction site where soft edges blend the dust and steel. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands firmly, holding blueprints that flutter slightly in the breeze. Next to him, a brown dog sits patiently, its tail curled around its paws while it looks up at the man. In the center, a woman in a yellow hard hat points decisively toward a towering steel beam, her arm extended with purpose. Beside her, a child in overalls watches intently, gripping a small toy truck with both hands. To the right, an old man in suspenders leans against a wooden crate, wiping sweat from his brow with a rag. A black cat perches atop the crate next to the old man, observing the scene with narrowed eyes. Nearby, a worker in green boots kneels on the ground, adjusting a loose bolt on a metal pipe. Behind the kneeling worker, a foreman in a striped shirt holds a clipboard, looking down at the progress. A parrot in a cage hangs from a crane hook above, squawking silently in the painted air. Finally, a girl in a pink dress stands near the edge of the frame, clutching a balloon string tightly. The man in the red scarf is handing a pencil to the woman in the yellow hard hat. The brown dog is sitting on a pile of sandbags. The child in overalls is looking at the toy truck. The black cat is next to the old man in suspenders. There is no heavy machinery like bulldozers or excavators visible in the background. There is no safety fencing or caution tape surrounding the perimeter.
